ps-basico:
D=/home/learner/aso/f31
ps -ef > $D/ps-ef.txt
ps aux > $D/ps-aux.txt
ps -o pid,ppid,user,stat,comm -p 1 > $D/pid1.txt
ps -o pid,ppid,user,comm -C supervisord > $D/supervisord.txt
pstree -p > $D/arbol.txt
trabajos:
bgl() { runuser -u learner -- setsid -f "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null; }
bgl sleep 3101
bgl sleep 3102
bgl sleep 3103
sleep 0.5
kill -STOP $(pgrep -fx 'sleep 3102')
printf '[2]+ %s Stopped                 sleep 3102\n' "$(pgrep -fx 'sleep 3102')" > /home/learner/aso/f31/jobs.txt
senales:
bgl() { runuser -u learner -- setsid -f "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null; }
kill -l HUP INT KILL TERM STOP CONT > /home/learner/aso/f31/senales.txt
bgl sleep 3104
bgl sleep 3105
bgl sleep 3106
sleep 0.5
kill -STOP $(pgrep -fx 'sleep 3104')
kill -STOP $(pgrep -fx 'sleep 3105')
kill -CONT $(pgrep -fx 'sleep 3105')
kill $(pgrep -fx 'sleep 3106')
sleep 0.5
pgrep-killall:
bgl() { runuser -u learner -- setsid -f "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null; }
cp /usr/bin/sleep /home/learner/aso/f31/dormilon
chown learner:learner /home/learner/aso/f31/dormilon
for i in 1 2 3; do bgl /home/learner/aso/f31/dormilon 600; done
sleep 0.5
pgrep -x dormilon > /home/learner/aso/f31/pids.txt
killall dormilon
sleep 0.5
